subjects: A small exquisite brass telescope on a short sturdy wooden tripod, accompanied by a folded cream tide-chart sheet with abstract faint teal contour lines (no coordinates or words), a dark teal lens cap and a tiny smooth sea-glass pebble. Maritime observation and patient curiosity. Telescope is the dominant clean silhouette, balanced diagonal tube, convincing simple optical instrument.

An elegant miniature Wardian glass plant case with a warm copper frame and tiny sage ferns inside, beside a blank folded seed-paper packet and a small terracotta pot holding one fresh green sprout. Clear airy glass, a few beautiful leaves rather than dense foliage, well-kept conservatory calm.

A small group of two beautifully crafted antique picture frames, one warm brass and one dark petrol wood, leaning together. The front frame contains an ORIGINAL simple painted nocturnal coastal scene with a small pale moon, deep indigo sky and tranquil sage sea (not a known artwork). A folded cream curator cloth and one tiny brass inventory tag with no markings at the base. Quiet evening gallery mood, restrained indigo accent.

A charming miniature deep petrol-teal postal sorting box with three little open pigeonholes holding cream envelopes and muted terracotta parcel cards, beside a tidy parcel tied with sage string and a small brass bell. A delicate frosting of snow rests only along the box roof edge, one evergreen sprig beside the parcel. Warm winter correspondence, not Christmas decorations, no lettering, numbers, stamps depicting faces, flags or logos.
